dbDown.title: Database unavailable
dbDown.body: The application cannot reach its metadata database. Most features will return errors until the connection is restored.
dbDown.pausedBodyBefore: The metadata database is unreachable, so navigation and data views are disabled to avoid showing inconsistent state. Use
dbDown.pausedBodyAfter: above (or wait for the next auto-retry) to resume.

warning.title: System Warning
warning.workspaceFailed: Databricks workspace connection failed. Some features may be unavailable.
warning.stillUnavailable: The workspace is still unreachable. Try again later.

routeError.title: Something went wrong
routeError.body: An unexpected error occurred while rendering this page. You can try again or go back to the home page.

issues.workspace_client_unavailable: The Databricks workspace client could not be created. The cause is in the server logs.
issues.manager_init_failed: Some services could not be initialized. The cause is in the server logs.
issues.seeding_failed: Default roles, teams or projects could not be created. The cause is in the server logs.
issues.database_unavailable: The metadata database could not be initialized. The cause is in the server logs.
